description: This file defines the class TestDataService within the namespace OrangeHRM\Tests\Util. It provides utility methods for managing test fixtures in a PHPUnit testing environment, including loading, populating, truncating database tables, and fetching records for testing purposes. The class interacts with Doctrine ORM and handles fixture data via YAML files, supporting features like data encryption and reference object creation.

classes.name: TestDataService
classes.description: A utility class for managing and loading test fixtures into the database for testing purposes. Provides methods to populate data, truncate tables, load fixtures, and retrieve specific records, with support for data encryption and reference handling.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Loads fixture data from a specified file into the database, with an option to reset the cache.

methods.name: _populateUsingPdoTransaction
methods.description: Handles transactional population of fixture data into the database using PDO, with cache management.

methods.name: _generatePdoInsertQueryArray
methods.description: Generates an array of SQL INSERT queries for a given table and data set.

methods.name: _generateMultipleInsertQueryArray
methods.description: Creates multiple insert queries for a dataset, handling variable column data.

methods.name: _generateInsetQueryColumnString
methods.description: Creates a column string for SQL insert statements based on data attributes.

methods.name: _getTableName
methods.description: Retrieves the table name associated with a class alias.

methods.name: _getClassMetadata
methods.description: Fetches the Doctrine ClassMetadata for a given entity alias.

methods.name: _setData
methods.description: Loads and parses fixture data from YAML file, and applies encryption if configured.

methods.name: _encryptFieldsInFixture
methods.description: Encrypts specified model fields in fixture data if encryption key is available.

methods.name: getFQEntityName
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name of an entity based on its alias.

methods.name: _setTableNames
methods.description: Populates internal table name list based on fixture data.

methods.name: _disableConstraints
methods.description: Disables database foreign key constraints before bulk operations.

methods.name: _enableConstraints
methods.description: Re-enables database foreign key constraints after bulk operations.

methods.name: _truncateTables
methods.description: Deletes data from specified tables and resets auto-increment counters.

methods.name: _getDbConnection
methods.description: Returns the native PDO database connection.

methods.name: truncateTables
methods.description: Public method to truncate specified tables by alias.

methods.name: truncateSpecificTables
methods.description: Public method to truncate specific tables using a list of aliases.

methods.name: fetchLastInsertedRecords
methods.description: Fetches the last N inserted records of a given entity.

methods.name: fetchLastInsertedRecord
methods.description: Fetches the most recently inserted record based on a specific order.

methods.name: fetchObject
methods.description: Retrieves a single object by primary key from the database.

methods.name: parseFixtureFile
methods.description: Parses YAML fixture files, with caching to optimize memory usage.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads fixture data for a specific key from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: loadObjectList
methods.description: Loads a list of objects from fixture data, converting raw arrays into entity instances.

methods.name: loadObjectListFromArray
methods.description: Converts an array of data into a list of entity objects for a given class alias.

methods.name: getFieldForColumn
methods.description: Gets the entity field name corresponding to a database column.

methods.name: getTypeForField
methods.description: Gets the data type of a specified field in the entity metadata.

methods.name: getAssociationMapping
methods.description: Retrieves association mapping information for a related entity.
